sentences.text:
This application coming on for hearing this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first application filed by the applicant u/s. 438 of Cr.P.C. on an apprehension of arrest relating to Crime No. 252/2016 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station, Special Police Establishment, District- Ujjain in the year 2016 for the offence punishable under Sections 120B,
420, 467, 468, 471 of I.P.C. and Sections 13(1)(D) & 13 (2) of Prevention from Corruption Act.

sentences.text: 2. Shri Vaibhav Jain, learned counsel for the respondent/establishment submits that t he investigation is complete now and request has been sent for grant of sanction from the concerned Department.
As on today, no notice has been issued to the applicant for appearance before the Court for filing of chargesheet.
At present, the prosecution is not intended to arrest the applicant as he has never been arrested during investigation since last so many years.

3. Shri Sanjay Sharma, learned counsel submits that now the stage of filing of charge-sheet has come and if Court dismisses the application filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. after considering on merit of the case, the applicant has strong apprehension of his arrest.
The co-accused viz. Naresh Tomar has already been enlarged on anticipatory bail by this Court vide order dated 26.4.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 16436/2023 and the applicant is having parity with him.
4. In case of Neerja Dutta v/s State (Government of N.C.T. Of Delhi) in Criminal Appeal No.1669/2009, Siddharth v/s State of U.P. In Criminal Appeal No.838/2021.

entities.text: Neerja Dutta v/s State (Government of N.C.T. Of Delhi)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In case of Satender Kumar Antil v/s Central Bureau Of Investigation on 11 July, 2022 SLP (CRL.) NO.5191 OF 2021, the Apex Court has held that at the time of filing of charge-sheet under Section 170 of the Cr.P.C. the accused is not liable to be arrested and sent to the custody, if he was not arrested during the investigation.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil v/s Central Bureau Of Investigation on 11 July, 2022 SLP (CRL.) NO.5191 OF 2021
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I have perused the record.
5. It is correct that during pendency of investigation, the applicant was never arrested.
The FIR was registered in the year 2016 and till today applicant has never been arrested.

There is no allegation against - : 3 :-
the applicant that he did not cooperate with the investigation or tried to tamper the evidence.
It is not the case of prosecution that it will seek custody of the accused at the time of filing of charge-sheet.
6. Keeping in view the fact in totality, without commenting on the merit of the case, application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant - Indramal S/o. Brijlal Bargode in connection with the aforesaid crime number, he shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.

This order shall be governed by the following conditions:
(a) the applicant shall co-operate with the investigation and make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;

With the aforesaid, this M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
